summary.zh: 从采购订单出发，跨 PO、收货、发票、FI 与付款凭证逐行项目判断端到端状态和阻塞原因。
summary.en: Traces each PO item across receipt, invoice, FI and payment documents to explain end-to-end status and blockers.

zh: 包含 PO 的自然语言问题
可选 PO item
查询基准日
SAP 凭证链证据（自动查询）
en: Natural-language question containing a PO
Optional PO item
As-of date
SAP document-chain data

zh: 逐行项目状态
数量与金额进度
阻塞原因
关联凭证证据
Markdown 或 JSON
en: Item-level status
Quantity and amount progress
Blocker explanations
Linked-document evidence
Markdown or JSON

zh: 只读追踪，不创建后续凭证
冲销与贷项按净额处理
仅有清账号不自动等同于付款
en: Read-only trace; never creates follow-on documents
Reversals and credits are netted
A clearing number alone is not assumed to be payment

title.zh: 解析用户输入并确定查询范围
title.en: Parse user input and establish scope

description.zh: 确定性解析用户问题，并与基准日及付款凭证类型配置合并成统一查询参数。
description.en: Deterministically parses the user's question and combines it with the as-of date and payment-document configuration.

zh: 从中英文自然语言问题中提取唯一采购订单号和可选项目号。
缺少采购订单、出现多个采购订单或项目表达有歧义时停止并返回明确错误。
基准日来自 --as-of，未提供时使用实际执行日；付款凭证类型来自 --payment-document-types 或默认配置。
将解析结果和运行配置合并为统一 QueryParameters，交给后续只读查询与分析。
en: Extract exactly one purchase order and an optional item from the Chinese or English question.
Stop with an explicit error when the purchase order is missing, multiple orders are present, or the item scope is ambiguous.
Take the as-of date from --as-of or the execution date, and payment document types from --payment-document-types or defaults.
Combine the extracted values and runtime configuration into QueryParameters for downstream read-only collection and analysis.

purpose.zh: 确定性提取 PO 和可选项目号。
purpose.en: Deterministically extracts the PO and optional item.

purpose.zh: 提供基准日和允许的付款凭证类型。
purpose.en: Supplies the as-of date and allowed payment document types.

purpose.zh: 本步骤不访问 SAP API，也不调用 SAPSkill。
purpose.en: This step does not call a SAP API or SAPSkill.

title.zh: 检查 SAP 只读 Provider

description.zh: 在访问真实 SAP 前确认所选 Provider 配置有效且严格只读，并验证目标服务 schema。
description.en: Confirms that the selected Provider is configured and strictly read-only before validating the target service schemas.

zh: 检查当前 SAP 只读 Provider，要求配置有效且 read_only=true。
调用 sap_read.schema，确认采购订单、物料凭证、供应商发票和会计凭证四个服务及必要字段可执行。
健康或 schema 检查失败时停止；主路径不启用 LLM-first。
en: Check the selected SAP read Provider and require valid configuration with read_only=true.
Call sap_read.schema to verify executable schemas and required fields for purchase orders, material documents, supplier invoices and accounting documents.
Stop when health or schema validation fails; the primary path does not enable LLM-first.

purpose.zh: 验证 Provider、SAP 配置和只读状态。
purpose.en: Validates the Provider, SAP configuration, and read-only state.

purpose.zh: 读取权威实体、字段、类型和可执行性。
purpose.en: Reads authoritative entities, fields, types and executability.

description.zh: 按精确 PO 过滤读取抬头和项目，建立后续凭证查询的业务范围。
description.en: Loads the header and items with an exact PO filter to establish the scope for subsequent document queries.

zh: 查询 A_PurchaseOrder，读取公司代码、供应商、凭证币种、采购订单日期和类型。
查询 A_PurchaseOrderItem，读取项目、物料、描述、工厂、订单数量、订单单位和删除/完成标志。
使用采购订单号进行服务端精确过滤，不下载无关采购订单。
读取所有页面直到 has_next=false；缺少抬头或项目时停止。
en: Query A_PurchaseOrder for company code, supplier, document currency, purchase-order date and type.
Query A_PurchaseOrderItem for item, material, description, plant, order quantity, order unit and deletion/completion indicators.
Apply an exact server-side purchase-order filter and do not download unrelated orders.
Read every page until has_next=false and stop when the header or items are missing.

purpose.zh: 通过 A_PurchaseOrder 和 A_PurchaseOrderItem 获取 PO 范围。
purpose.en: Provides PO scope through A_PurchaseOrder and A_PurchaseOrderItem.

purpose.zh: 执行字段受控、服务端过滤的只读 GET。
purpose.en: Executes field-controlled, server-filtered read-only GET requests.

description.zh: 按 PO item 读取收货、退货和冲销，并用一致单位计算有效净收货数量。
description.en: Loads receipts, returns and reversals by PO item and calculates valid net receipt quantity in a consistent unit.

zh: 查询 A_MaterialDocumentItem，按 PO/item 读取物料凭证、移动类型、数量、单位、借贷标识和冲销引用。
按物料凭证号和年度查询 A_MaterialDocumentHeader，补充过账日期和抬头冲销信息。
排除取消记录，并按借贷标识、反向移动类型及冲销凭证对收货、退货和冲销做净额计算。
单位一致时输出净收货数量；无法可靠换算时停止数量结论并标记证据冲突。
en: Query A_MaterialDocumentItem by PO/item for document keys, movement type, quantity, unit, debit/credit code and reversal references.
Query A_MaterialDocumentHeader by material-document number and year to add posting dates and header reversal evidence.
Exclude cancelled records and net receipts, returns and reversals using debit/credit codes, reverse movement types and reversal documents.
Return net received quantity only in a consistent unit; stop the quantity conclusion when conversion is not reliable.

purpose.zh: 通过 A_MaterialDocumentItem 和 A_MaterialDocumentHeader 提供 GR、退货和冲销证据。
purpose.en: Provides GR, return and reversal evidence through A_MaterialDocumentItem and A_MaterialDocumentHeader.

purpose.zh: 按 PO 和物料凭证技术键执行完整分页查询。
purpose.en: Executes complete paged queries by PO and material-document keys.

title.zh: 读取并验证供应商发票

description.zh: 从 PO item 找到供应商发票，并验证过账、贷项和冲销状态。
description.en: Finds supplier invoices from each PO item and validates posting, credit-memo and reversal status.

zh: 查询 A_SuplrInvcItemPurOrdRef，按 PO/item 获取发票号、年度、项目、数量、金额、单位和币种。
使用发票号和年度查询 A_SupplierInvoice，读取发票状态、过账日期、贷项和冲销字段。
只统计已过账且未被冲销的有效发票，并将贷项和冲销按负向证据净额处理。
IsFinallyInvoiced=false 仅表示未设置最终发票标志，不能否定已经找到的已过账发票。
en: Query A_SuplrInvcItemPurOrdRef by PO/item for invoice number, year, item, quantity, amount, unit and currency.
Query A_SupplierInvoice by invoice number and year for status, posting date, credit-memo and reversal fields.
Count only posted, non-reversed invoices and net credit memos and reversals as negative evidence.
IsFinallyInvoiced=false only means that the final-invoice indicator is not set; it does not negate an observed posted invoice.

purpose.zh: 通过 A_SuplrInvcItemPurOrdRef 和 A_SupplierInvoice 提供 PO 发票证据。
purpose.en: Provides PO invoice evidence through A_SuplrInvcItemPurOrdRef and A_SupplierInvoice.

purpose.zh: 按 PO 引用和发票技术键执行只读查询。
purpose.en: Executes read-only queries by PO reference and invoice technical keys.

title.zh: 串联 FI 与付款证据

description.zh: 从供应商发票定位 FI 供应商行，再沿清账键确认付款凭证类型。
description.en: Locates the FI supplier line from the supplier invoice and follows clearing keys to confirm the payment document type.

zh: 从供应商发票 API 取得 SupplierInvoice 和 FiscalYear，形成发票到 FI 的技术关联输入。
在 A_OperationalAcctgDocItemCube 中通过 OriginalReferenceDocument 定位发票 FI 会计凭证。
读取 FI 供应商行、付款冻结、NetDueDate、交易币种金额和清账字段。
从 ClearingAccountingDocument 和 ClearingDocFiscalYear 取得清账凭证技术键。
再次查询清账凭证并读取 AccountingDocumentType，确认清账动作的业务类型。
仅当清账凭证类型属于配置集合 KZ、ZP、PY 或显式客户映射时判定付款；非付款清账保持未付款。
存在明确部分付款引用时，按已付金额占发票供应商行金额的比例分配到相关 PO item。
en: Take SupplierInvoice and FiscalYear from the supplier-invoice API as the technical input for invoice-to-FI linking.
Use OriginalReferenceDocument in A_OperationalAcctgDocItemCube to locate the invoice FI accounting document.
Read the FI supplier line, payment block, NetDueDate, transaction-currency amount and clearing fields.
Take ClearingAccountingDocument and ClearingDocFiscalYear as the clearing-document technical key.
Query the clearing document again and read AccountingDocumentType to confirm the business nature of the clearing action.
Classify payment only when the clearing type belongs to KZ, ZP, PY or an explicit customer mapping; non-payment clearing remains unpaid.
When an explicit partial-payment reference exists, allocate the paid ratio from the invoice supplier-line amount to its PO items.

purpose.zh: 通过 A_OperationalAcctgDocItemCube 提供 FI 发票行、清账和付款凭证证据。
purpose.en: Provides FI invoice-line, clearing and payment-document evidence through A_OperationalAcctgDocItemCube.

purpose.zh: 按 PO、原始参考凭证、FI 凭证和清账凭证键执行串联查询。
purpose.en: Executes chained queries by PO, original reference, FI document and clearing-document keys.

description.zh: 将多 API 结果映射到统一 P2P 数据契约，并执行完整性、单位、币种和敏感信息检查。
description.en: Maps multi-API results into the unified P2P contract and checks completeness, units, currencies and sensitive data.

zh: 把采购订单、物料凭证、供应商发票和会计凭证实体映射为 EKKO/EKPO、MKPF/MSEG、RBKP/RSEG、BKPF/BSEG 语义。
确认每个查询均读取到 has_next=false，并保存运行 ID、SAP client、技术键、来源工具和分页状态。
检查跨 API 技术键、单位和币种一致性；缺页、权限错误或证据冲突时输出 INCONCLUSIVE。
生成不含凭据、银行信息或完整供应商敏感数据的 evidence 快照；SAPSkillhub 仅可选补证，本次验证主路径未使用。
en: Map purchase-order, material-document, supplier-invoice and accounting-document entities to EKKO/EKPO, MKPF/MSEG, RBKP/RSEG and BKPF/BSEG semantics.
Confirm that every query reaches has_next=false and save the run ID, SAP client, technical keys, source tool and pagination state.
Validate cross-API technical keys, units and currencies; return INCONCLUSIVE for missing pages, permission errors or conflicting evidence.
Create an evidence snapshot without credentials, bank data or full supplier-sensitive data; SAPSkillhub is optional supplemental evidence and was not used in the validated primary path.

purpose.zh: 保存脱敏 API 请求、实体和完整性元数据。
purpose.en: Stores sanitized API requests, entities and completeness metadata.

purpose.zh: 把 evidence JSON 映射为 P2PTables。
仅在存在明确匹配的只读 skill 时补证；本次真实验证未使用。
purpose.en: Supplements evidence only when an explicitly matching read-only skill exists; none was used in the live validation.

description.zh: 按最早未完成阶段判定每个 PO item，并输出数量、金额、阻塞原因和技术凭证链。
description.en: Classifies each PO item by its earliest incomplete stage and presents quantities, amounts, blockers and technical document chains.

zh: 按删除、收货、发票和付款的前序未完成优先级计算项目状态，并叠加异常而不覆盖主状态。
对收货、发票、贷项、冲销和付款金额做净额及发票级分摊，避免多项目发票重复计款。
输出项目级状态、数量和金额进度、阻塞或异常原因，以及 GR、Invoice、FI 和 Payment 技术凭证键。
生成 Markdown 或稳定 JSON；整个流程保持只读，不创建或修改任何 SAP 凭证。
en: Calculate item status using deletion, receipt, invoice and payment precedence, adding anomalies without replacing the primary state.
Net receipts, invoices, credits, reversals and payments and allocate at invoice level to avoid double-counting multi-item invoices.
Return item status, quantity and amount progress, blocker or anomaly explanations, and GR, Invoice, FI and Payment technical keys.
Produce Markdown or stable JSON while the entire workflow remains read-only and creates or changes no SAP document.

purpose.zh: 执行跨对象关联、净额计算、付款分摊和证据检查。
purpose.en: Performs cross-object linking, netting, payment allocation and evidence checks.

purpose.zh: 执行稳定的状态优先级和异常叠加。
purpose.en: Applies stable state precedence and anomaly overlays.

purpose.zh: 生成人类可读和机器可读结果。

description.zh: 只输入采购订单号，例如 4500000030；不要输入完整句子。
description.en: Enter only the purchase-order number, for example 4500000030; do not enter a sentence.

steps.rationale: Load every item for the requested PO.
Load receipt, return and reversal evidence.
Load supplier-invoice references for the PO.
Load FI clearing and payment evidence linked to the PO.
Load the clearing document itself so payment is never inferred from a clearing reference alone.

plan.rationale: Follow the PO through goods receipt, supplier invoice and FI evidence using GET-only SAP APIs.
